# Marine Systems Simulator utilities

This folder contains the MSS functions used by the Otter model in
`src/mpc/otter3DOF.m`: rigid-body transformations, hydrodynamic forces, and
kinematic mappings. `setupProject` adds `GNC/` and `HYDRO/` to the MATLAB path.

Upstream project: [Marine Systems Simulator](https://github.com/cybergalactic/MSS).
The original source notices and [license](LICENSE) are retained.

Reference: T. I. Fossen and T. Perez (2004), *Marine Systems Simulator (MSS)*.
The underlying models and algorithms are described in T. I. Fossen (2021),
*Handbook of Marine Craft Hydrodynamics and Motion Control*, 2nd edition, Wiley.
